title: Jackass: Best and Last
plot_overview: The crew reunites for one last outrageous run, revisiting the reckless stunts and chaotic spirit that made the franchise a hit. Blending fresh antics with a look back at familiar moments, this final installment offers a farewell for longtime fans.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you’re a longtime fan seeking familiar outrageous antics, nostalgic moments, and a farewell, but Not for you if you want consistently fresh material or dislike gross-out humor and reckless stunts.
review_summary: Pros: familiar chaotic humor; nostalgic farewell; some fresh antics | Cons: relies on old footage; uneven new stunts; gross-out humor
